Class AbstractMethodMessageHandler<T>

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.messaging.handler.invocation.AbstractMethodMessageHandler<T>
Type Parameters:
T - 包含将 HandlerMethod 映射到传入消息的对象信息的类型
All Implemented Interfaces:
Aware, InitializingBean, ApplicationContextAware, MessageHandler
Direct Known Subclasses:
SimpAnnotationMethodMessageHandler
public abstract class AbstractMethodMessageHandler<T> extends Object implements MessageHandler, ApplicationContextAware, InitializingBean
Abstract base class for HandlerMethod-based message handling. Provides most of the logic required to discover handler methods at startup, find a matching handler method at runtime for a given message and invoke it.

同时也支持发现和调用异常处理方法，以处理消息处理过程中抛出的异常。

Since:
4.0
Author:
Rossen Stoyanchev，Juergen Hoeller

    • setDestinationPrefixes

      public void setDestinationPrefixes(@Nullable Collection<String> prefixes)
      When this property is configured only messages to destinations matching one of the configured prefixes are eligible for handling. When there is a match the prefix is removed and only the remaining part of the destination is used for method-mapping purposes.

      默认情况下，未配置任何前缀，此时所有消息均符合处理条件。

    • setApplicationContext

      public void setApplicationContext(@Nullable ApplicationContext applicationContext)
      描述从接口复制：ApplicationContextAware
      Set the ApplicationContext that this object runs in. Normally this call will be used to initialize the object.

      在普通 Bean 属性填充之后、但在初始化回调（例如 InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()）或自定义 init-method 之前调用。在 ResourceLoaderAware.setResourceLoader(ResourceLoader)、ApplicationEventPublisherAware.setApplicationEventPublisher(ApplicationEventPublisher) 和 MessageSourceAware（如果适用）之后调用。

      Specified by:
      `setApplicationContext` 在接口 `ApplicationContextAware` 中。
      Parameters:
      applicationContext - 此对象将使用的 ApplicationContext 对象
      See Also:
      • BeanInitializationException

    • getLookupDestination

      protected @Nullable String getLookupDestination(@Nullable String destination)
      Check whether the given destination (of an incoming message) matches to one of the configured destination prefixes and if so return the remaining portion of the destination after the matched prefix.

      如果没有匹配的键前缀，则返回null。

      如果没有目标前缀，则原样返回目的地。

      protected @Nullable InvocableHandlerMethod getExceptionHandlerMethod(HandlerMethod handlerMethod, Exception exception)
      查找给定异常的 `@MessageExceptionHandler` 方法。默认实现首先在 `HandlerMethod` 的类层次结构中搜索方法，如果未找到，则继续在已配置的 MessagingAdviceBean 中搜索额外的 `@MessageExceptionHandler` 方法（如果有）。
      Parameters:
      handlerMethod - 抛出异常的方法
      exception - 抛出的异常
      Returns:
      处理该异常的null方法，或为null。
      Since:
      4.2
